cases.sentence: Когда Иовин, ___ Хацора, услышал об этом, он послал сообщить другим царям.
cases.translation: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to other kings.
cases.explain: Царь is the nominative predicate, identifying who Jabin was.

cases.translation: They went out with all their warriors.
cases.explain: The instrumental plural follows the preposition со (with) indicating the accompaniment.

cases.sentence: Они выступили со всеми своими воинами и большим количеством ___.
cases.translation: They went out with all their warriors and a great number of horses.
cases.explain: The genitive plural follows 'количеством' (quantity of) in the phrase 'большим количеством коней'.

cases.translation: The Lord said to Joshua, 'Hamstring their horses.'
cases.explain: The dative plural is used with the verb перережь (hamstring) meaning 'to cut the tendons of the horses'.

cases.sentence: Он перерезал жилы их коням и сжег их ___.
cases.translation: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
cases.explain: The accusative plural follows the transitive verb сжег (burned).

cases.sentence: В то время Иисус повернул назад, взял Хацор и предал его ___ мичу.
cases.translation: Joshua turned back and struck the king with the sword.
cases.explain: The accusative singular follows the verb предал (handed over) as the direct object.

cases.sentence: Всех, кто в нем был, они предали мечу, уничтожив их полностью, никого не оставили в живых, а сам город он сжег ___.
cases.translation: He burned the city with fire.
cases.explain: The instrumental singular follows the verb сжег (burned) indicating the instrument used for burning.

cases.sentence: Кроме Хивеев, что в Гаваоне, ни один ___ не заключил мира с израилетянами.
cases.translation: No city except the Hivites in Gibeon made peace with Israel.
cases.explain: The nominative singular serves as the subject of the verb 'заключил' (made).

reading.ru: Когда Иовин, царь Хацора, услышал об этом, он послал сообщить Иоваву, царю Мадон, царям Шемрона и Ахсафа и царям, которые жили в северных Нагорьях.
reading.question: What was Jabin's response to hearing about Joshua's victories?
options: He sent messages to other kings in the northern regions to unite against Israel
He immediately surrendered his city to Joshua
He gathered his people and fled to Egypt
He sent ambassadors to make peace with Israel
reading.correct: He sent messages to other kings in the northern regions to unite against Israel
reading.explain: The text says Иовин послал сообщить other kings, showing that he sent messages to unite them against Israel.

reading.ru: Они выступили со всеми своими воинами и большим количеством коней и колесниц, огромным войском, многочисленным, как песок на морском берегу.
reading.question: How large was the army that assembled against Israel?
options: Enormous, as numerous as the sand on the seashore, with many horses and chariots
A small group of a few thousand warriors
Mainly infantry with very few chariots
A force sent by Egypt to defend Canaan
reading.correct: Enormous, as numerous as the sand on the seashore, with many horses and chariots
reading.explain: The text describes the army as огромным войском, многочисленным, как песок на морском берегу — enormous, numerous as sand on the shore.

reading.ru: Господь сказал Иисусу, «Не бойся их, потому что завтра к этому времени я отдам всех их Израилю убитыми.»
reading.question: What did the Lord promise Joshua regarding the enemy army?
options: He would deliver them all slain to Israel by the next day
God would send angels to help him
The enemy would retreat on their own
reading.correct: He would deliver them all slain to Israel by the next day
reading.explain: The Lord promised завтра к этому времени я отдам всех их Израилю убитыми — by tomorrow I will deliver them all slain to Israel.

reading.ru: Иисус и все его войско внезапно вышли на них возле реки Мирома и напали, а Господь отдал их в руки Израиле.
reading.question: How did Joshua achieve victory over the northern coalition?
options: He attacked suddenly by the waters of Merom, and the Lord delivered them into Israel's hands
He used a trick with chariots to confuse the enemy
He set fire to the enemy camps at night
He made a secret alliance with some of the kings
reading.correct: He attacked suddenly by the waters of Merom, and the Lord delivered them into Israel's hands
reading.explain: The text states Иисус и все его войско внезапно вышли на них возле реки Мирома и напали, а Господь отдал их в руки Израиле — Joshua attacked suddenly and the Lord delivered them.

reading.ru: Так Иисус захватил всю эту землю, Нагорье, весь Негев, всю область Гошен, западные предгорья и Орданскую долину и горы Израиля с их предгорьями.
reading.question: What territory did Joshua conquer as a result of his northern campaign?
options: All the hill country, the South, Goshen, the lowlands, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel with their foothills
Only the region around Hazor and a few surrounding cities
The coastal cities and the territories of the Philistines
The territories east of the Jordan River
reading.correct: All the hill country, the South, Goshen, the lowlands, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel with their foothills
reading.explain: The text describes Иисус захватил всю эту землю, Нагорье, весь Негев, всю область Гошен, западные предгорья и Орданскую долину и горы Израиля — Joshua captured the hill country, South, Goshen, lowlands, and mountains.

reading.ru: Кроме Хивеев, что в Гаваоне, ни один город не заключил мира с израилетянами.
reading.question: What was unique about Gibeon among the Canaanite cities?
options: Only Gibeon made peace with the Israelites
Only Gibeon refused to fight against Israel
Gibeon was the strongest fortress in Canaan
Gibeon was already destroyed before Joshua arrived
reading.correct: Only Gibeon made peace with the Israelites
reading.explain: The text states Кроме Хивеев, что в Гаваоне, ни один город не заключил мира с израилетянами — Except the Hivites in Gibeon, no city made peace with Israel.
